capture_notes.method: Selected factual fields manually transcribed from official sources returned by the web research tool; reviewed by Codex.
capture_notes.scope: Three deliberately selected board models with potential cross-retailer correspondences; this is not a complete catalog or a representative sample.
capture_notes.meaning_of_raw: Original field spellings and displayed values, not original page HTML or API responses. Factual selections and evidence locations are retained; full copyrighted pages and PDFs are linked rather than republished.
capture_notes.direct_http_check: A separate direct request for Adafruit 6006 returned HTTP 403; hidden currency metadata was not verified. The accessible rendered page remains the evidence for its displayed fields.

records.locator: Main product heading, Product ID and price; Description first paragraph; final purchase/status panel.
records.notes: The retained price is a displayed listing price; no current purchase availability is implied. A retailer's status is not a global product discontinuation.

records.locator: Product heading and purchase panel; Does not include; Features & Specs; Available Discounts.
records.notes: Numeric available quantity is not published in the selected evidence. Product-page navigation carousels contain unrelated prices and availability and were excluded.

records.locator: Product heading and Product ID; final price/status panel; selected version in variant selector.
records.notes: Other selector entries refer to different products; their prices were not attributed to 4864.

records.locator: Product heading and purchase panel; Features & Specs; overview packaging note.
records.notes: The overview describes tape-and-reel sourcing and separately discusses a full reel of 2400 units; that number is not a stock count or the default listing pack quantity.

records.locator: Product ID and final purchase panel; No Header selection; Description paragraphs 2 and 4; Technical Details memory bullet; dated silicon note.
records.notes: The page contradicts itself on SRAM. Its old dated A2 note does not verify the silicon revision shipping at capture time.

records.locator: Product heading and purchase panel; Features & Specs memory and CPU bullets.

fields.cpu_choice: Dual Arm Cortex-M33 or dual RISC-V Hazard3

records.notes: An older $5 description is marketing text, not the $5.75 purchase-panel price. The model title is the plain Pico 2, not W or with headers.

records.locator: Opening product-code table; recommended accessories; Specifications; Design Changes; Regulatory Compliance.
records.notes: Current manufacturing is a design-level role, not proof of who produced any particular retailer unit. The physical MCU suffix depends on manufacture date. TEENSY40 is PJRC's design code; it was not extracted as a SparkFun MPN.

records.locator: Models table; Raspberry Pi Pico variants table; Key features for non-wireless boards; Raspberry Pi Pico 2 variants table and key features.
records.notes: Only the two named non-wireless variants are extracted. H / with headers and W variants are separate identities. Unrelated wireless specifications elsewhere on the page are not applied to these boards.

records.locator: Colophon: PDF page 2 (index 1). About Raspberry Pi Pico 2: PDF page 5 (index 4), printed page 4. Differences from Raspberry Pi Pico: PDF page 7 (index 6), printed page 6.
records.notes: RP2350A here is a chip/package design designation, not proof of A2 silicon stepping in either retailer's current stock. The ambiguous numeric build date is retained without an invented ISO date.
SparkFun explicitly states that its website uses USD. This corroborates currency for S02, S04 and S06; it does not establish Adafruit currency.
